title: 88Vape Any Tank Sweet Cherry 10ml E-Liquid- 3mg
description: Cherry Sherbet from 88Vape's Anytank series is a vibrant and playful e-liquid that perfectly captures the sugary sweetness of a classic candy favourite. The e-liquid bursts into life with the rich and sweet taste of cherries, offering a rush of fruity flavour that's both bold and enticing. This is complemented by the fizzy, tangy notes of sherbet, which add a delightful effervescence to the mix. This unique combination results in a delightful interplay between the sweet cherry and the sugary sherbet, creating an e-liquid that's both nostalgic and refreshingly modern. The sherbet's fizziness lifts the cherry's sweetness, offering a multi-layered taste experience that's sure to delight vapers looking for something sweet yet tangy. This 50/50 e-liquid from 88Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing delicious flavour, smooth throat yet tactile throat hit and satisfying clouds. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. 88Vape are one of the most popular and bestselling vape brands in the UK. They have helped countless smokers make the switch to the far safer alternative of vaping with the help of delicious e-liquids at wallet-friendly prices.
